reply.text:
Mostly nay if size and strength are the goal. Cold water right after lifting seems to blunt some of the muscle-building signal, so if you plunge, give it a few hours after your session, or keep it for days you didn't train.

It does make you feel fresher and can help between hard sessions when you need to perform again soon, so it's a tool, not a sin. Sleep, food, and the training itself are doing the heavy lifting on recovery.

If you've got a heart condition or any health concern, check with your doctor before you start plunging.
